title: Key
description:
Key is a Hydra Labyrinth: With each level won, the maze gets bigger and harder.
- Beat 100 levels in normal mode.
- Enjoy pixel art graphics with 2D graphic lighting visual effects.
- Listen to relaxing music and comfortable sounds while playing.
- Beat 100 levels in hard mode.
- Beat 10 levels in christmas mode.
- Find 4 hidden Gems.

Game Time: 20 Hours.

Will you be able to help our hero find the key before the time is up?
 

FEATURES

Gems!
 

Push!
 

Boots, Map and Stair/Teleport!
 

Have fun playing and relaxing in Key
description_short: Spend hours having fun exploring this maze that gets bigger and bigger. In Key, with each level won, the maze gets bigger and harder. Dodge spikes and traps, push blocks of ice, find the key and open the door before time runs out.
